title: Components of a system and what may happen to each environment as a whole

defaultBranch.description: Branch deploy-all runs from when a component does not set its own.

environments.description: One entry per environment group. Every group needs an environments/<group>.json.

protected.description: Never removed, whatever else this file says. Use it for production and anything people depend on.

deployAll.description: Deploy-all may roll out this environment.

redeploy.description: Redeploy may re-run the last good versions in this environment.

remove.description: Remove may tear this environment down.

pipeline.description: Name of the Azure DevOps pipeline that deploys this component. It takes a parameter 'environment'.

branch.description: Branch deploy-all runs from; defaults to defaultBranch.

environmentSuffix.description: The component deploys to '<system> - <group> - <suffix>' instead of '<system> - <group>'.

resourceGroup.description: Resource group the component owns. '{env}' is replaced by the environment group. Remove deletes it.

cleanup.description: Removal of orphaned role assignments: assignments whose principal no longer exists.

resourceGroupPattern.description: Wildcard pattern of the resource groups to scan; '{env}' is replaced by the environment group.

protectedRoleNames.description: Never deleted, even when orphaned. Review those by hand.

minimumAgeDays.description: Only assignments older than this are candidates; directory replication can briefly hide a new principal.

maxOrphanRatio.description: Circuit breaker: refuse when more than this share of the assignments looks orphaned. That smells like a lookup problem, not like orphans.

minimumAssignmentsForRatioCheck.description: Below this many assignments the ratio is meaningless and not checked.
